ei.title: 2번: A Heart Syndrome Caused by Extreme Emotions
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: Broken heart syndrome, also known as takotsubo syndrome (TTS), is a condition that occurs when stress weakens the heart's ability to pump blood. TTS can occur after stressful events such as the loss of a family member or a natural disaster. Surprisingly, researchers say people can also get TTS when happy things occur, sometimes referring to this as "happy heart syndrome." A researcher discovered this while analyzing data from 1,750 patients with takotsubo syndrome. Of the 485 patients diagnosed after emotional events, 20 had experienced happy events. The researcher concluded that the brain reacts similarly to extremely positive and negative events, so both can result in takotsubo syndrome.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

② physical injuries: 신체적 부상은 감정 이야기와 무관
③ daily routines: 일상은 발병 계기와 거리가 멂

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ③ 행복한 일(긍정적 감정)도 유발 가능(happy heart syndrome) → 일치

③ 극도로 긍정적인 감정도 타코츠보 증후군을 유발 ←정답
④ 노인에게만 나타난다는 내용은 본문에 없음

① 뇌와 심장: both 앞에 나온 두 대상이 아님
② 극도로 긍정적인 사건과 부정적인 사건: 둘 다 병을 유발한다는 문맥 ←정답
③ 가족의 상실과 자연재해: 스트레스성 사건의 예시일 뿐 both의 지시 대상이 아님
④ 환자 수: 수치일 뿐 both과 무관
det.tip: both = 바로 앞의 두 축 = 긍정적 사건 + 부정적 사건

questions.passage: Broken heart syndrome, also known as takotsubo syndrome (TTS), is a condition that occurs when stress weakens the heart's ability to pump blood. TTS can occur after __________ such as the loss of a family member or a natural disaster. Surprisingly, researchers say people can also get TTS when happy things occur, sometimes referring to this as "happy heart syndrome." A researcher discovered this while analyzing data from 1,750 patients with takotsubo syndrome. Of the 485 patients diagnosed after emotional events, 20 had experienced happy events. The researcher concluded that the brain reacts similarly to extremely positive and negative events, so both can result in takotsubo syndrome.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: joyful moments=즐거운 순간 / medical exams=의료 검사 / stressful events=스트레스성 사건 / daily meals=일상 식사
det.analysis:
빈칸 뒤 예시가 '가족의 상실이나 자연재해'
① joyful moments: 상실·자연재해는 즐거운 순간이 아님
② medical exams: 의료 검사는 예시와 무관
③ stressful events: 상실·자연재해를 포괄하는 스트레스성 사건 ←정답
④ daily meals: 식사와 무관
det.tip: such as the loss... or a natural disaster(예시) → stressful events

questions.passage: Broken heart syndrome, also known as takotsubo syndrome (TTS), is a condition that occurs when stress weakens the heart's ability to pump blood. TTS can occur after stressful events such as the loss of a family member or a natural disaster. questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 빈칸을 완성하시오. (영어로)
'둘 다 타코츠보 증후군을 초래할 수 있다'
[조건] (1) both, can, result, in, takotsubo, syndrome을 모두 사용
(2) 6단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: both can result in takotsubo syndrome = 둘 다 타코츠보 증후군을 초래할 수 있다
det.analysis: 주어 both(둘 다) + 조동사 can + 동사구 result in(~을 초래하다) + 목적어 takotsubo syndrome 순서예요. result in은 '~라는 결과를 낳다'라는 뜻의 한 덩어리 표현이라 in을 빠뜨리면 안 돼요.
det.tip: both(주어) + can + result in(초래하다) + takotsubo syndrome(목적어)

questions.wa: both can result in takotsubo syndrome
accept: both can result in takotsubo syndrome

questions.passage: Broken heart syndrome, also known as takotsubo syndrome (TTS), is a condition that occurs when stress weakens the heart's ability to pump blood. TTS can occur after stressful events such as the loss of a family member or a natural disaster. Surprisingly, researchers say people can also get TTS when happy things occur, sometimes referring to this as "happy heart syndrome." A researcher discovered this while analyzing data from 1,750 patients with takotsubo syndrome. Of the 485 patients diagnosed after emotional events, 20 had ①<u>experiencing</u> happy events. The researcher concluded that the brain reacts similarly to extremely positive and negative events, so both can result in takotsubo syndrome.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①은 어법상 틀렸다. 어법에 맞게 올바른 형태로 고쳐 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: experiencing → experienced: had 뒤에는 과거분사가 오므로(과거완료) experienced가 맞아요.
det.analysis:
밑줄이 든 부분: '20 had ___ happy events(20명이 행복한 일을 겪었다)'.

① 앞에 had가 있어요. had + 과거분사 = 과거완료 시제예요.

② 그러므로 동사는 -ing형(experiencing)이 아니라 과거분사 형태가 와야 해요.

③ 따라서 experiencing이 아니라 experienced가 맞아요. 'had experienced = (그전에) 겪었다'. (experience: 겪다, 경험하다)
det.tip: had + 과거분사 = 과거완료 → had experienced

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 빈칸을 완성하시오. (영어로)
'타코츠보 증후군을 가진 1,750명의 환자로부터 얻은 데이터'
[조건] (1) data, from, 1,750, patients, with, takotsubo, syndrome을 모두 사용
(2) 7단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: data from 1,750 patients with takotsubo syndrome = 타코츠보 증후군을 가진 1,750명의 환자로부터 얻은 데이터
det.analysis: 핵심 명사 data(데이터)를 앞에 두고, 두 개의 전치사구로 꾸며요. from 1,750 patients(1,750명의 환자로부터) + with takotsubo syndrome(타코츠보 증후군을 가진). 전치사 from은 '~로부터', with는 '~을 가진'의 뜻이에요.
det.tip: data(명사) + from 1,750 patients(출처) + with takotsubo syndrome(어떤 환자인지)

questions.wa: data from 1,750 patients with takotsubo syndrome
accept: data from 1,750 patients with takotsubo syndrome

questions.passage: Broken heart syndrome, also known as takotsubo syndrome (TTS), is a condition that occurs when stress weakens the heart's ability to pump blood. TTS can occur after stressful events such as the loss of a family member or a natural disaster. Surprisingly, researchers say __________, sometimes referring to this as "happy heart syndrome." A researcher discovered this while analyzing data from 1,750 patients with takotsubo syndrome. Of the 485 patients diagnosed after emotional events, 20 had experienced happy events. questions.stem:
다음 주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하여 빈칸을 완성하시오. (9단어, 영어로)
[also, can, get, happy, occur, people, things, TTS, when]

det.korean: people can also get TTS when happy things occur = 사람들은 행복한 일이 생길 때도 TTS에 걸릴 수 있다
det.analysis:
주어(people) + 조동사(can) + 부사(also) + 동사(get) + 목적어(TTS) + 시간 부사절(when happy things occur) 순서예요.

① 먼저 주어 people을 놓고, can + also + 동사원형 get을 이어요('~도 걸릴 수 있다').

② 목적어 TTS 뒤에 '언제'를 설명하는 when절(when happy things occur)을 붙여요.
det.tip: S(people) + can also + V(get) + O(TTS) + when절(happy things occur)

questions.wa: people can also get TTS when happy things occur
accept: people can also get TTS when happy things occur
when happy things occur people can also get TTS

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 빈칸을 완성하시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 핵심 명사 a condition(질환)을 관계대명사 that이 꾸며요. that occurs(발생하는) + 시간 부사절 when stress weakens(스트레스가 약화시킬 때). that 뒤 동사 occurs는 선행사 condition이 단수라 -s가 붙어요.
